summary: claude was substantially more accurate on this image. The core identity disputes go to claude: the tapered brass helical stack is a single cone gear seen side-on (claude marked it correctly; codex mis-split it into two 'cylinder gears' and wrongly called the cone occluded), and the one clearly-visible cylinder gear is the bright brass end-gear whose hub claude nailed. On the rocker fan, claude's tip corners sit at the real arm end near the post while codex's were ~200px short at mid-span, and the butt/pivot corners are genuinely buried in the linkage (claude's 'occluded' is right; codex's points are on the bracket). Systematic codex errors: gear misidentification, mid-span rocker tips, a mirrored front/back label convention on the left-side corners (claude's naming is the one consistent with the back-left orientation, with the near corner = back_left), and several analyzer corners drifted up onto the face or onto screw heads instead of the true bottom/outer corners.
